description: Suggests a new place for Little Milwaukee: a locally owned place in Milwaukee County that would make less sense anywhere else. Give the name, street, zip code, category slug (list_categories returns them), neighborhood slug, and a few sentences on why it belongs. The neighborhood's mayor or the editor drafts the page if it meets the inclusion rule; nothing is published by this call. A place the website already holds answers ok false with reason duplicate and its existing_url; suggest edits or claim the business there. The answer holds a status_url for the decision.

category.description: A category slug, for example fish-fry.

contact.description: An email or phone for the outcome; only the mayor and the editor see it.

name.description: The place's name, up to 200 characters.

neighborhood.description: A neighborhood slug, for example riverwest.

note.description: Why the change is right, for the mayor and the editor.

source_url.description: A web address where a person can check the new value, such as the business's own page. Strongly preferred.

street.description: The street address, up to 200 characters.

why.description: Who owns it and why it belongs, 20 to 2000 characters.

name: suggest_place
